support_evidence_summary: The evidence establishes that: 1) The manuscript for BWV 1033 is in the hand of Carl Philipp Emanuel Bach (from chunk 1). 2) Carl Philipp Emanuel Bach's second name was given in honor of his godfather Georg Philipp Telemann (from chunk 3). Therefore, the German musician whose hand wrote the manuscript (C.P.E. Bach) had Georg Philipp Telemann as his godfather.
